candidates.source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (institution/market participant search)
candidates.why_relevant: The master public register of every entity licensed or registered by the MNB: credit institutions, financial enterprises, payment institutions, e-money issuers, investment firms, funds, plus foreign providers passporting into Hungary and MNB/foreign warning lists. Converts the unknown HU regulated population into a named list whose own IR/press channels become sources.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the advanced search by institution type (pénzpiac / tőkepiac / biztosító / pénztár) and activity type; snapshot result tables periodically and diff to detect new/withdrawn licences. Check for XLS/CSV export on result pages before scraping HTML.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search on MNB register terms, then fetch of the portal
queries_used: MNB engedéllyel rendelkező pénzforgalmi intézmények listája
MNB piaci szereplők keresője felügyelt intézmények nyilvántartás

candidates.source_name: MNB – Piaci szereplők keresése (register hub page)
candidates.why_relevant: Hub page that enumerates all MNB register instruments: general search, intermediary search, special databases, cross-border activity lists. The single best crawl seed for discovering every MNB-run register.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the page to detect newly added register/database links; treat each outbound link as a child source.
queries_used: MNB piaci szereplők keresője felügyelt intézmények nyilvántartás

candidates.source_name: MNB – Közvetítők keresése (intermediary / agent register)
candidates.why_relevant: Separate registers for money-market (Hpt.) and insurance (Bit.) intermediaries, including dependent/independent agents and cross-border agents. This is the agent-register layer of the cell: it names the distribution channel population behind banks and PIs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search by activity type (független/függő/határon átnyúló közvetítő) in Intézménykereső's intermediary tabs; snapshot and diff.
queries_used: MNB felügyelt intézmények nyilvántartás közvetítők
MNB piaci szereplők keresője felügyelt intézmények nyilvántartás

candidates.source_name: MNB – Speciális adatbázisok (special registers)
candidates.why_relevant: Index of niche registers: BEVA-eligible participants, EU covered bond label issuers, prospectus registers, authorised security printers, training organisations, cross-border fund manager agents. Each is a small named-actor list useful for enumerating adjacent payments/banking suppliers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the SpecialData?name=... endpoints under intezmenykereso.mnb.hu that this page links to; each is a stable list URL.
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetch of MNB register hub; snowballed

candidates.source_name: MNB – Magyar székhelyű intézmények határon átnyúló tevékenységei (outbound passporting lists)
candidates.why_relevant: Lists Hungarian payment institutions and credit institutions that passport services into other EEA states — identifies which HU payments actors are regionally expansionist, a direct lead-generation list.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the linked SpecialData lists for 'határon átnyúló pénzforgalmi intézmények' and 'hitelintézetek'; diff quarterly.

candidates.source_name: MNB – Pénzforgalmi intézmény engedélyezés (licensing conditions & process page)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative statement of what a payment institution licence requires under Fsztv./Hpt., with sub-pages for tevékenységi engedély and személyi engedély. Explains the legal gates that determine who can appear in the register and on what timeline.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor page + linked PDF engedélyezési útmutatók for revisions (hash the PDFs).

candidates.source_name: MNB – Elektronikuspénz-kibocsátó intézmény (EMI licensing pages)
candidates.why_relevant: The EMI counterpart of the PI licensing branch; defines the e-money issuer category whose members are then enumerable via Intézménykereső. Needed to build the correct Hungarian query vocabulary for EMI searches.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor page + engedélyezési útmutató PDF; cross-reference EMI names into Intézménykereső.

candidates.source_name: MNB – Határozatok és végzések keresése (supervisory decisions database)
candidates.why_relevant: Searchable decisions by sector and decision type (engedélyezés, jogérvényesítés, piacfelügyelet, fogyasztóvédelem). Licence grants, withdrawals and sanctions appear here before/alongside register changes — the event stream that explains why a register entry moved.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parameterised search per sector (pénzpiac) filtered to engedélyezés and piacfelügyelet, paginated; store decision number, date, entity, type. Decision numbering scheme is documented on a sibling page.
queries_used: alk.mnb.hu határozat kereső jegybank engedélyezési határozatok adatbázis

candidates.source_name: MNB alkalmazás-portál (alk.mnb.hu) – legacy supervision search apps
candidates.why_relevant: The underlying application host serving MNB's decision and warning search results, with paginated URLs (?pagenum=N) and an /en/ variant — a far more scrape-friendly surface than the CMS pages.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Iterate pagenum parameter on hatarozatok_keresese and figyelemsearch/listall; parse result rows. Rate-limit politely.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu search results exposing the app host; snowballed from mnb.hu

candidates.source_name: MNB – Hazai figyelmeztetések / jogosulatlan szolgáltatók (domestic warning lists)
candidates.why_relevant: The negative image of the licence register: entities operating without authorisation, and MNB immediate prohibition orders. Useful for scoping grey-market payments activity and for validating that a counterparty is genuinely licensed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the domestic warnings list and the alk.mnb.hu figyelemsearch endpoint monthly; diff entity names.

candidates.source_name: MNB – Pénzforgalmi intézmények adatszolgáltatás page
candidates.why_relevant: Supervisory reporting obligations and deadlines specific to payment institutions — the compliance calendar that drives PI behaviour, and a pointer to which data MNB collects (hence which aggregates may later be published).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track page revisions and attached MNB decrees / reporting tables (adatszolgáltatási táblák) each year-end when the next-year reporting decree is published.
queries_used: MNB engedéllyel rendelkező pénzforgalmi intézmények listája

candidates.source_name: MNB – Kriptoeszköz-szolgáltatók (CASP/MiCA) engedélyezés
candidates.why_relevant: MNB is the MiCA competent authority for Hungary; from 1 July 2025 CASPs need an MNB licence or an EU passport. A new, fast-moving licensed-actor population adjacent to payments, enumerable through the same Intézménykereső once entries appear.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch MNB CASP guidance pages and search Intézménykereső for kriptoeszköz-szolgáltató entries; cross-check against ESMA's MiCA register for passported firms.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu search on MiCA/CASP register terms
queries_used: MNB MiCA kriptoeszköz-szolgáltatók nyilvántartás engedélyezett Magyarország 2025

candidates.source_name: EBA central register of payment and e-money institutions (PSD2)
candidates.why_relevant: Mirrors MNB's national register daily and adds passporting detail, in a downloadable machine-readable form. The most practical bulk-extraction route for the Hungarian PI/EMI/PISP/AISP population, and it also shows which foreign PIs passport into Hungary.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the full register export, filter home country = HU, and additionally filter host-country = HU to capture inbound passporting. Schedule monthly and diff.
queries_used: EBA payment institutions register PSD2 credit institutions register Hungary

candidates.source_name: ECB list of Monetary Financial Institutions (MFI) – Hungary
candidates.why_relevant: Daily-updated authoritative list of HU credit institutions and money market funds, downloadable in bulk with stable identifiers — a clean deposit-taking-institution universe to join against MNB register names.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pull the MFI dataset from the ECB Data Portal / MID download area (gzip files), filter country=HU; join to MNB register by name and company id.
queries_used: ECB list of monetary financial institutions MFI Hungary download register

candidates.source_name: Cégszolgálat Online Céginformáció (e-cégjegyzék) – official company register
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory Hungarian company register (cégjegyzék). Resolves every licensed bank/PI/EMI/agent to a legal entity: cégjegyzékszám, seat, share capital, owners, officers, and status (felszámolás, végelszámolás). Reportedly offers machine-readable XML company data.
candidates.legal_status: official_public_register; some extracts fee-based under 2006. évi V. törvény
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Look up entities by name/cégjegyzékszám on the free online céginformáció interface; for scale, evaluate the Céginformációs Szolgálat's paid customised data-supply (adatszolgáltatás) and XML export rather than scraping.
queries_used: cégjegyzék e-cégjegyzék céginformációs szolgálat hivatalos cégadatok lekérdezés im.gov.hu

candidates.source_name: Céginformációs Szolgálat (Ministry of Justice company information service)
candidates.why_relevant: The state body governing access to company-register data, including bulk/customised data supply terms. Determines what is legally collectable from the cégjegyzék and at what price — a licensing/access gatekeeper for any register-based enumeration pipeline.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read the adatszolgáltatás / díjszabás pages once to establish legal collection route; re-check annually.
queries_used: cégjegyzék e-cégjegyzék céginformációs szolgálat hivatalos cégadatok lekérdezés im.gov.hu

candidates.source_name: e-beszámoló portál (statutory financial statements)
candidates.why_relevant: Free filed annual accounts for every Hungarian company, including PIs, EMIs, fintechs and payment agents that are too small for MNB statistics. Turns a register name into revenue, headcount proxy and ownership narrative.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search by company name or cégjegyzékszám and download the PDF/e-beszámoló packages annually (filings cluster around the 31 May deadline).
queries_used: cégjegyzék e-cégjegyzék céginformációs szolgálat hivatalos cégadatok lekérdezés im.gov.hu

candidates.source_name: GIRO Zrt. – klíringtagok (BKR direct clearing participants)
candidates.why_relevant: Names every institution with direct access to the Hungarian interbank clearing system (BKR/GIROInstant). This is the operational, not merely legal, list of payment-capable institutions — the highest-value subset for payments infrastructure work.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape or snapshot the klíringtagok table quarterly; diff to detect new joiners (often signals a new PI/fintech going live).

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Tagjaink (banking association member list)
candidates.why_relevant: Curated list of 40+ member institutions with individual member profile pages (including infrastructure firms such as GIRO Zrt.), each carrying contact and website details — a fast route from register name to the actor's own disclosure channels.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl tagjaink and the tagreszlet.cshtml?tagId=N profile pages to harvest member websites as seeds for later per-actor source discovery.
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagjai lista GIRO BKR közvetlen résztvevők bankok

candidates.why_relevant: Archived register structures from the PSZÁF/early-MNB era. Valuable for historical baselining — reconstructing which institutions existed in earlier years and how categories were named before the current taxonomy.

candidates.source_name: MNB – Pénzfeldolgozási tevékenység engedélyezése (cash-processing licence)
candidates.why_relevant: A separate MNB licence category covering cash-processing (CIT/cash-handling) firms — directly adjacent to ATM/branch/self-service hardware markets and often overlooked because it sits outside the main felügyelet register tree.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read page for the licence framework and check whether a list of licensed pénzfeldolgozók is published or must be derived from Intézménykereső activity-type filters.

negative_findings.description: No downloadable CSV/XLSX/API export of the MNB Intézménykereső result sets was identified from the pages inspected; the portal appears to be a form-driven HTML search with 'SpecialData?name=...' list endpoints for niche lists only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk extraction of the full HU licensed-institution population may require HTML parsing of paginated results, or falling back to the EBA PSD2 register export and the ECB MFI download for the PI/EMI and credit-institution slices respectively.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines pipeline design and cost for the core actor-enumeration step; an undetected export would waste scraping effort, and an assumed export that does not exist would break the pipeline.

negative_findings.description: A dedicated, separately published list of payment-institution AGENTS (pénzforgalmi közvetítők / PSD2 agents) was not located as its own page; agent data appears to live inside the Intézménykereső intermediary tabs (Hpt./Bit. based), which are oriented to money-market and insurance intermediaries.
negative_findings.result_summary: PSD2 agent enumeration for Hungary may be more reliably obtained from the EBA central register's agent records than from a HU-only page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell explicitly targets agent registers; mis-locating them would leave the distribution layer of the payments market unmapped.

negative_findings.description: MNB MiCA/CASP licensing guidance was found, and secondary Hungarian media assert several exchanges now hold MNB authorisation, but no official MNB-published list of licensed kriptoeszköz-szolgáltatók was located at a stable URL in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: CASP enumeration currently rests on Intézménykereső queries and the ESMA MiCA register rather than a dedicated MNB list page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Crypto-asset service providers are a new regulated population directly adjacent to payments; missing the authoritative list risks relying on media claims, which must not be treated as register facts.

negative_findings.description: The exact boundary between free and fee-based company-register access (e-cegjegyzek.hu / Céginformációs Szolgálat) was not pinned down; free 'online céginformáció' exists but full extracts and bulk/XML supply appear to be chargeable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as partly_paid with legal collection routed through the Céginformációs Szolgálat's adatszolgáltatás rather than scraping.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bulk scraping a fee-based statutory register would be a legal and contractual risk; the access terms must be read before any pipeline is built.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice were obtained from search results and, for four of them, from successful content fetches; the remainder were not individually fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: No URL here is claimed as verified-live; a deterministic liveness pass should confirm. Any 403/timeout should be read as bot-defence, not as a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false 'dead source' verdicts on bot-defended government portals such as alk.mnb.hu and e-cegjegyzek.hu.

coverage_gaps.description: Registers for the non-bank consumer-lending and financial-enterprise segment (pénzügyi vállalkozás), and for independent ATM operators, were not separately mapped in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run Intézménykereső advanced search by institution activity type to enumerate 'pénzügyi vállalkozás' entries, and search hu terms 'ATM üzemeltető engedély' / 'készpénzkifizetés bankjegykiadó automata'.

coverage_gaps.description: No machine-readable API/open-data endpoint for HU registers was identified (e.g. an MNB open-data or data.gov.hu dataset mirroring the licensed-institution list).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search for 'MNB nyílt adat', 'data.gov.hu pénzügyi intézmények', and inspect intezmenykereso.mnb.hu network traffic for a JSON backend before committing to HTML scraping.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial Hungarian company-data aggregators (e.g. Opten, Bisnode/Dun & Bradstreet HU, Céginfo) were not assessed; they typically offer licensed bulk company data that would remove the cégjegyzék paywall friction.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess two or three commercial HU company-data vendors for licensed bulk access, coverage of financial-sector NACE codes, and API availability.

coverage_gaps.description: Foreign PIs/EMIs/credit institutions passporting INTO Hungary were only partially covered (via the EBA register); no HU-side page listing inbound cross-border providers was confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Look for an MNB special database of 'külföldi székhelyű intézmények magyarországi határon átnyúló szolgáltatásai' under the specialis-adatbazisok tree, and cross-check against EBA host-country filters.

coverage_gaps.description: Cégközlöny (the official company gazette) and Magyar Közlöny were not confirmed as reachable structured sources in this pass, despite being the statutory publication channel for company events and for legal acts creating deadlines.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate the current official Cégközlöny and Magyar Közlöny portals and assess archive/search structure; these anchor the 'deadlines' topic for A3.

brief: Hungary's regulated-actor population is unusually well enumerable: the MNB runs a single master register portal (Intézménykereső) plus a documented hub of intermediary, special and cross-border databases, backed by a searchable supervisory-decisions database and domestic warning lists that explain register movements. For payments specifically, the MNB national register is mirrored daily into the EBA PSD2 central register, which is the only confirmed bulk-downloadable route to the HU payment-institution and e-money-institution universe; the ECB MFI list plays the same role for credit institutions. Legal-entity resolution and financials come from the statutory cégjegyzék (e-cegjegyzek.hu, partly fee-based via the Céginformációs Szolgálat) and the free e-beszámoló filings portal, while GIRO's klíringtag list and the Bankszövetség membership give the operational, infrastructure-level view. Main open risks are the absence of a confirmed machine-readable export from the MNB portal itself, an unclear free/paid boundary on the company register, and no located official list of newly licensed MiCA crypto-asset service providers.
